map.alt: Map of Ruins of Lordaeron in WoW Forever, with where each boss stands

abilities.name: Hurled into the air
abilities.description: Throws the tank into the air and stuns him for 5 seconds. Damage dealers, watch your threat: the tank is on him only about half the fight.

abilities.name: A patrol
abilities.description: Clear his room before the pull: a patrol walks by. His head is looted for the quests Abominable Creatures and Unending Torment.

abilities.name: Spiders of the courtyard
abilities.description: Nothing special on the boss itself. Clear the other spiders of the courtyard first, or they join the fight.

trigger.text: Clear the courtyard, click the statue and survive the waves: she comes after them.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.description: Frost damage to the whole group. Healers, pace your mana through the waves.

abilities.name: Knockback
abilities.description: Knocks you back: clear the packs around him first, or you land in one.

abilities.name: Anti-Magic Shield
abilities.description: Shields himself against spells for a while.

abilities.name: Heavy blows
abilities.description: He hits hard: keep the tank topped up.

abilities.name: Flamestrike
abilities.description: His main spell. He can be interrupted and stunned: plan your kicks and stuns.

abilities.name: A large health pool
abilities.description: The longest fight of the dungeon. Keep the interrupts going and bring him down.

trigger.text: Clear the house and the statue, click the fireplace and survive the waves. He comes after the last flesh golem.

abilities.name: Poison
abilities.description: Poisons his target. Watch the health bars.

abilities.name: Heavy blows
abilities.description: He hits hard: keep the tank healthy. Bring mana potions for the waves before him.
